mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.title, v.url, v.duration, v.category, v.description, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.student_id) as recommendedToStr FROM teacher_action_videos v LEFT JOIN teacher_action_video_recommendations r ON r.video_id = v.id
AND v.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED)
AND v.category = #{category}
GROUP BY v.id, v.title, v.url, v.duration, v.category, v.description ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_action_videos (title, url, duration, category, description, teacher_id, class_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{url}, #{duration}, #{category}, #{description}, #{teacherId}, #{classId}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO teacher_action_video_recommendations (video_id, student_id, teacher_id, comment, created_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{comment}, NOW())
